bibl.title: Attention Is All You Need
bibl.publisher: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: method
span.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

span.label: neural sequence transduction (machine translation)
span.quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: replace recurrence and convolution with self-attention - every position attends to all others in parallel, capturing long-range dependencies and enabling fast parallel training
span.quote: based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely

span.label: Reducing long-range dependencies to a constant number of operations costs effective resolution, which the authors only partly offset with multi-head attention.
span.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

span.label: On the constituency-parsing generalisation test the Transformer is still beaten by one prior model.
span.quote: Our results in Table 4 show that despite the lack of task-specific tuning our model performs surprisingly well, yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [8].

span.label: Label smoothing, which they use, degrades perplexity even as it helps BLEU.
span.quote: This hurts perplexity, as the model learns to be more unsure, but improves accuracy and BLEU score.

span.label: Hyperparameters for the parsing experiments were barely tuned.
span.quote: We performed only a small number of experiments to select the dropout, both attention and residual (section 5.4), learning rates and beam size on the Section 22 development set, all other parameters remained unchanged from the English-to-German base translation model.

span.label: The scaling factor every later implementation copies is justified by a suspicion.
span.quote: We suspect that for large values of dk, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has extremely small gradients

span.label: The two candidate position encodings performed the same, and the one adopted was chosen on a conjecture about behaviour never tested here.
span.quote: We also experimented with using learned positional embeddings [9] instead, and found that the two versions produced nearly identical results (see Table 3 row (E)). We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training

span.label: The interpretability claim is hedged in both of its clauses.
span.quote: As side benefit, self-attention could yield more interpretable models. We inspect attention distributions from our models and present and discuss examples in the appendix. Not only do individual attention heads clearly learn to perform different tasks, many appear to exhibit behavior related to the syntactic and semantic structure of the sentences

span.label: The attention mechanism adopted is the one that loses in a stated regime, and it was chosen for implementation speed.
span.quote: While for small values of dk the two mechanisms perform similarly, additive attention outperforms dot product attention without scaling for larger values of dk

span.label: self-attention
span.quote: As side benefit, self-attention could yield more interpretable models

span.label: multi-head attention
span.quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions

span.label: attention function
span.quote: An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output, where the query, keys, values, and output are all vectors

span.label: additive attention
span.quote: The two most commonly used attention functions are additive attention [2], and dot-product (multiplicative) attention

span.label: dot-product attention
span.quote: Dot-product attention is identical to our algorithm, except for the scaling factor

span.label: attention - AS A LOOKUP, NOT AS ANYTHING PSYCHOLOGICAL: an attention function maps a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output, all of them vectors, so the word names a weighted retrieval operation and carries none of its ordinary or cognitive meaning
span.quote: An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output, where the query, keys, values, and output are all vectors

span.label: the field's name for what this became - ABSENT FROM IT: `large language model` occurs nowhere in this paper, nor do `foundation model` or `pretraining`; the architecture is introduced as a sequence transduction model evaluated on translation, and the vocabulary now used to describe its descendants postdates it entirely
span.quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality

span.label: two attention functions, and the slower-but-better one was not taken: additive attention beats unscaled dot-product attention at larger key dimensions, and dot-product was adopted because it runs as optimised matrix multiplication - a choice made on speed with a correction bolted on
span.quote: The two most commonly used attention functions are additive attention [2], and dot-product (multiplicative) attention

span.label: 28.4 — WMT 2014 English-to-German translation score (new state of the art)
span.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 Englishto-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles

span.label: The Transformer is a sequence-transduction architecture based SOLELY on attention, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely — more parallelizable and faster to train.
span.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.

span.label: It reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-German, beating prior best (incl. ensembles), using scaled dot-product and multi-head attention.
